text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flash!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...How about it?
choice_data_list: This is how the photo turned out, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, what is this face?! Why am I
looking so serious here~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I want to send a photo of me in my Racewear to my family."
Ines Fujin had come to me with that request,
so I was helping her with the photoshoot today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hmm, it's funny, but...! It's funny, but it's just not quite right...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, can I take one more picture?
Since they asked to see it, I really want to send the best one possible...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, thankies!
Alright, next up is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Like this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Or... like this!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: If that still doesn't work... then take this~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... You took so many photos for me,
but somehow, it still just doesn't feel quite right...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking over the captured photo data together,
it was certainly, how should one put it—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The picture I want taken is of me in my Racewear.
I want to show everyone, "Look, I'm running!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Dad, Mom, my little sisters...
It's because everyone gave me that push
that I'm standing here today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Running, doing what I love,
getting so much support... That's why...
the thing I want my family to see most is—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Exactly that!
Trainer, let's head to the track!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, I'm gonna run with all my might right now!
With everyone's support...
I wanna show them that I can run toward my dream!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No retakes! We only have one shot,
so make sure you get a great picture, okay? Pretty please!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yup, I'm counting on you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Taaahhh---!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin sprints with just as much fervor as in a real race.
In a rush—yet keeping a close eye on her run, I snap the shutter.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flash!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *wheeze*... *huff*, *puff*...!
How was it!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing off the photo taken with utter confidence.
What was captured there was—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...Ah... Ahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With glittering eyes just like during a race,
Ines Fujin stared straight ahead.
She looked so cool—and like she was having so much fun.
choice_data_list: That's Ines in her racing outfit for you!
That's Ines in her racing outfit for you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... As I thought, this was the missing piece!
It's such an amazing photo!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for hanging out with me so much!
Ehehe, I'm gonna send you the photos right away!
choice_data_list: We got the best photo ever!
Since we're here, I'll send you all the photos I took!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for hanging out with me so much!
Ehehe, I'm gonna send you the photos right away!
choice_data_list: We got the best photo ever!
Since we're here, I'll send you all the photos I took!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! I'm sure they'll love it!
And... send.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I need to get changed
and get to training soon!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, Mom already replied!
Let's see, what does it sayâ

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for the photo! It's such a relief to see
you doing so well and having fun.
Your little sisters also..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"She was overjoyed and set a cool photo
of her big sis as her lock screen!"
...It says!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I knew it!
You really are the best at capturing 'me as I am right now,' Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin looked overjoyed.
The photoshoot in her racing racewear
seemed to have been a wonderful experience...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
No, no, no, I took some weird ones too!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
The ones we just took... Ah, look!
Like this one where we're making hearts,
or this weirdly smug face...! And there's more!
choice_data_list: I think it's not bad, but...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Be. Cause! I'm supposed to be
known as the reliable big sister...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yup, this is a secret between me and Trainer!
I'll have to sort it into a folder later.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's change and practice, practice!
I have to do my best so I can look cool
in the actual race too!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin dashingly ran off.
Seeing her cool running style made me realize
I need to keep supporting her with everything I have.
